title: Slingshot Mod
description: A slingshot that can fling you or insta-kill mobs
body:
Slingshot Mod
Adds a powerful slingshot item to the game with two abilities:
Right-click — Launches you in the direction you're looking. Great for flying off cliffs, launching yourself over mountains, or just getting around fast.
Right-click while aiming at a mob — Flings you AND instantly kills the mob in your crosshair. Works up to 30 blocks away.
Crafting Recipe:
S . S
S W S
. S .
S = Stick, W = String
Or get it instantly with:
/give @s slingshot:slingshot
Requirements:


**Fabric API
Minecraft 1.21.1**
